import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

input_path = os.path.join(inputs_dir, 'sales.csv')
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)
df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]

# Normalize expected columns
rename_map = {}
for c in df.columns:
    lc = c.lower()
    if lc == 'month':
        rename_map[c] = 'Month'
    elif lc == 'year':
        rename_map[c] = 'Year'
    elif lc == 'sales':
        rename_map[c] = 'Sales'
    elif lc == 'category':
        rename_map[c] = 'Category'
df = df.rename(columns=rename_map)

df['Month'] = df['Month'].astype(str).str.strip()
df['Category'] = df['Category'].astype(str).str.strip()
df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
df['Sales'] = df['Sales'].astype(float)

# Build a numeric time index (year + month fraction) for scatter x-axis
month_num = {
    'January': 1, 'February': 2, 'March': 3, 'April': 4,
    'May': 5, 'June': 6, 'July': 7, 'August': 8,
    'September': 9, 'October': 10, 'November': 11, 'December': 12
}
df['MonthNum'] = df['Month'].map(month_num).fillna(0).astype(int)
df['TimeIndex'] = df['Year'] + (df['MonthNum'] - 1) / 12.0

# Sort chronologically for consistent plotting
df = df.sort_values(['TimeIndex', 'Category']).reset_index(drop=True)

out_path = os.path.join(output_dir, 'cleaned_data.csv')
df.to_csv(out_path, index=False)

state_out = {
    'n_rows': int(len(df)),
    'categories': sorted(df['Category'].unique().tolist()),
    'years': sorted(df['Year'].unique().tolist())
}
